name: Incarnate
description: Dragon Ruler was still the most represented strategy in Road of the King's February–March 2014 results after the four large Dragons became Semi-Limited. Chronomaly was the next largest group, often paired with Artifacts.

defining_cards.name: Tempest, Dragon Ruler of Storms
defining_cards.why: It supplied repeatable Level 7 material and could search a Dragon by discarding itself with another WIND monster.

defining_cards.name: Chronomaly Nebra Disk
defining_cards.why: Its Normal Summon searched a Chronomaly card, and it could revive itself on a later turn for a Rank 4 play.

defining_cards.name: Blue-Eyes White Dragon
defining_cards.why: Dragon Shrine could send this Normal Monster first, then send another Dragon to set up the Graveyard.

defining_cards.name: Blaster, Dragon Ruler of Infernos
defining_cards.why: This Level 7 Dragon could return from the Graveyard as Xyz material or trade two FIRE cards for removal.

defining_cards.name: Dragon Shrine
defining_cards.why: Sending a Normal Dragon first unlocked a second send, stocking the Graveyard for Dragon Rulers.
